Negation####azurerm_network_interface.ip: If azurerm_network_interface.a.dns_servers is null or empty, Then azurerm_network_interface.a.ip_configuration.0.public_ip_address_id is null (i.e. it does not refer to azurerm_public_ip.id)
If azurerm_network_interface.a.dns_servers is null or empty, Then azurerm_network_interface.a.ip_configuration.0.public_ip_address_id is null (i.e. it does not refer to azurerm_subnet.id)
Reference####azurerm_network_interface.i: If azurerm_network_interface.a.dns_servers is null or empty, Then azurerm_network_interface.a.ip_configuration.0.public_ip_address_id depends on azurerm_public_ip.b.id
If there is azurerm_public_ip.b.sku == Basic, Then azurerm_network_interface.a.ip_configuration.0.public_ip_address_id depends on azurerm_public_ip.b.id
If there is azurerm_public_ip.b.allocation_method == Dynamic, Then azurerm_network_interface.a.ip_configuration.0.public_ip_address_id depends on azurerm_public_ip.b.id
If azurerm_network_interface.a.dns_servers is null or empty, Then azurerm_network_interface.a.ip_configuration.0.subnet_id depends on azurerm_subnet.b.id
